# Introducing Isaac: Your New AI Assistant at WellnessLiving

![Introducing Isaac: Your New AI Assistant at WellnessLiving](https://www.wellnessliving.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/Isaac-Blog-Cover-2-1024x683-1.jpeg)

Last Updated on 3 September, 2025

Are you wondering if WellnessLiving offers an AI assistant? The answer is yes! Meet [Isaac, WellnessLiving’s incredible AI assistant](https://www.wellnessliving.com/features/isaac/). Powered by OpenAI’s GPT-4, Isaac is your new go-to helper, seamlessly built into the WellnessLiving platform to supercharge your support experience.

Why the buzz about Isaac? Well, we’re tapping into a major shift— [83% of organizations](https://www.tidio.com/blog/ai-statistics/) are now harnessing Generative AI to streamline customer interactions. And it’s about time because while [73% of customers expect](https://getzowie.com/blog/stats-ai-customer-service) to switch effortlessly between communication channels like chat, email, and phone, only a third of companies are up to speed. Isaac bridges this gap, providing seamless and integrated support experiences.

Read on to discover how this clever assistant can revolutionize your daily operations and transform your interactions with WellnessLiving.

## Transforming Customer Support with AI Technology

As we evolve beyond traditional phone and email support, Isaac introduces a dynamic new way to engage with our support team. This cutting-edge AI tool is designed to provide immediate, personalized assistance whenever you need it—day or night.

Isaac is always on, providing 24/7 assistance to ensure that no matter when a question arises—be it during a late-night work session or amid a busy day—you have reliable support. Trained to search our extensive Knowledge Base of over 1,600 articles, Isaac quickly fetches accurate answers, streamlining your workflow and reducing downtime.

But Isaac offers more than just quick answers. It understands the nuances of your requests, from setting up new memberships to adjusting client information, ensuring that the guidance you receive is specifically tailored to your needs. This level of personalized support not only simplifies your operations but also enhances your overall experience by ensuring that each interaction is relevant and effectively addresses your unique concerns.

With Isaac, you’re equipped with more than just an AI assistant; you have a dynamic support partner that adapts to your business needs, transforming how you interact with WellnessLiving.

## Is Isaac Replacing Human Support?

While Isaac significantly enhances our support capabilities, rest assured, it’s not here to replace our human support team. Transitioning from AI to live human support is effortless—just a click away—ensuring that you always have access to a personal touch when needed.

If Isaac can’t answer your question, we’ll promptly connect you to the right human support agent. Our expert staff are equipped to handle more complex issues with the understanding and empathy that only humans can offer. They’re not just quick—they’re contextually aware. If you have urgent questions about a client’s profile or a report, our live chat instantly connects you with a knowledgeable agent who sees where you are in the software and guides you to the right solution quickly, eliminating any vague or unhelpful responses.

Moreover, integrating AI technology like Isaac allows us to collect valuable insights from every interaction. This data helps us continuously refine and personalize the support you receive, ensuring it’s always relevant and effective. Think of Isaac as an extension of our human team—an innovative tool that enhances our ability to serve you better, while preserving the irreplaceable human connection that is fundamental to excellent customer service.

## What If You Need to Leave the Conversation?

Every interaction with our support team is streamlined for easy access directly within the software interface. Forget the hassle of manual note-taking or digging through your email inbox—everything is neatly organized exactly where you need it.

Are you concerned about losing important messages if you have to step away? With Isaac, you can leave the conversation at any moment and return whenever you’re ready. Rest assured, your entire communication thread is securely saved, meaning no lost messages or confusion; your conversation history remains intact, allowing you to pick up exactly where you left off.

Our system is designed to accommodate your busy lifestyle. Whether you’re teaching a class or stepping out for an errand, you can easily resume your conversations without missing a beat, ensuring you never lose track of a support issue, no matter your schedule.

## How Do You Get Started?

Getting started with Isaac is simple. Just look for the help icon in the bottom left  corner of your screen with the WellnessLiving backend and click to open. Type your question and let Isaac start assisting you right away! Why not give it a try tonight? Those late work hours could become your most productive yet with Isaac by your side.

We’re excited to see how Isaac can make a difference in your day-to-day operations, but we need your input to make it even better. After each chat, take a moment to tell us how it went by clicking “That Helped” or “Talk to Human.” Your feedback is invaluable—it helps Isaac learn and grow smarter with every interaction.

Start your journey with Isaac today and see how easy and efficient managing your tasks can be with a little help from our advanced AI. Every response you give helps us enhance Isaac and our chat support, ensuring we continue to deliver the support you need, exactly when you need it.
